purpose: Materialize the fully validated HeartFetter Lv4/Lv7 research presentation mapping as a small frozen production presentation consumer so Hero frontend code can render per-job effects without reading research policy, raw conditions or ConfigData and without deriving any new relation.

consumerLookup.heroLocator: Find the manifest HERO_MAP shard whose explicit ids list contains heroId, then read heroes[String(heroId)].
consumerLookup.skillTextLocator: Find the manifest SKILL_TEXT shard whose explicit ids list contains skillId, then read skills[String(skillId)].
consumerLookup.jobDisplayMetadata: Resolve presentationJobId only against the already-loaded frozen Hero shard's exact jobId metadata; do not infer by name, order, arithmetic or source filenames.
consumerLookup.effectText: The SKILL_TEXT lookup preserves the validated Skill source descriptionCn exactly. Localization is a later presentation overlay and must not change the frozen job/effect relation.

completionCriteria: The tracked manifest and six shards reproduce exactly from the validated research presentation builder.
All 267 Heroes and all 1,158 Lv4/Lv7 effect rows are present exactly once.
All 1,066 referenced Skill IDs resolve to one exact source description in this consumer.
Mapping-mode counts are 1,142 default, six explicit override, eight Matthew exclusion-set and two Narm source-conflict resolution rows.
Every presentationJobId is already validated by the research presentation policy and no frontend relation reconstruction is required.
The consumer is production presentation authority only and does not resolve generic ConditionType=7 semantics or mutate canonical Hero relations.
reopenConditions: Any validated HeartFetter research input or frozen Hero job identity changes.
The exact ConditionType=7 runtime predicate is authoritatively resolved and contradicts the presentation mapping.
A source/contract/schema change invalidates the published consumer lookup contract.
